intents.answer: The semester examination dates are officially published in the college academic calendar and examination schedule notification. Please check the latest notification on the college notice board or student portal for exact dates.

intents.answer: Most colleges conduct 2 to 3 Internal Assessment Tests (Mid-terms/Unit Tests) per semester. The schedule and syllabus are released by your respective academic departments at least one week prior to the tests.

intents.answer: End-semester examinations are the comprehensive university/college theory exams held at the conclusion of each semester, covering the full course syllabus as prescribed in the curriculum.

intents.answer: The examination timetable is available on the college examination portal and department notice boards. It contains subject-wise dates, session timings (Forenoon: usually 9:30 AM - 12:30 PM, Afternoon: 1:30 PM - 4:30 PM), and subject codes.

patterns: how to find my exam hall

intents.answer: Exam hall and seating arrangements are displayed on the central examination notice board and near the main entrance at least 45 minutes before the start of each examination session. Seating is arranged according to student register/roll numbers.

intents.answer: Hall tickets (Admit Cards) can be downloaded from the student portal or collected from your department office a few days before exams commence. Carrying the original printed hall ticket along with your college ID card is strictly mandatory for every exam.

patterns: how to register for semester examination
exam form fill up process

how to apply for regular exams
exam application form submission
steps to fill semester exam form
intents.answer: Exam registration is completed through the college Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) or examination portal. Students must verify their registered subjects, pay the prescribed exam fee, and submit the printed confirmation form to the department before the announced deadline.

patterns: what is the exam fee

what is the fine for late exam fee payment
fee per theory subject and practical paper
examination fee structure
intents.answer: Examination fees vary by regulation and number of theory/practical courses registered. Payments are accepted online via the student fee portal. Late payments may attract a penalty fine as per examination cell guidelines.

patterns: what is the attendance requirement

can I write exam if attendance is low
minimum percentage of attendance required
is 75 percent attendance compulsory
attendance criteria for appearing in exam
what if my attendance is below 75 percent
can low attendance student attend exams
intents.answer: Students are required to maintain a minimum of 75% aggregate attendance in each subject to be eligible for semester examinations. Students having attendance between 65% and 74% due to medical or approved reasons may apply for condonation with appropriate documents.

patterns: what are the eligibility criteria for semester exams
am I eligible to write the exam
exam eligibility rules
who is allowed to sit for semester examinations
conditions for appearing in final exams
criteria to appear for end semester exam
intents.answer: To be eligible for semester examinations, a student must: (1) Meet the minimum 75% attendance requirement, (2) Complete all continuous internal assessment requirements, (3) Clear all college tuition/exam dues, and (4) Complete official exam registration.

patterns: when are supplementary exams conducted

supplementary exam fee and registration

how to clear failed subjects in supplementary exam
re-exam procedure for failed papers
intents.answer: Supplementary (Arrear/Remedial) examinations are usually conducted alongside regular semester exams or during vacation periods. Students can register for backlogs by submitting the supplementary exam form and paying the per-subject fee on the examination portal.

patterns: how can I apply for revaluation

intents.answer: Students dissatisfied with their results can apply for paper revaluation within 7 to 14 days of result publication. The application must be submitted through the student portal along with the prescribed revaluation fee per subject.

patterns: how to apply for retotalling

retotalling fee and application deadline

how to request answer paper photocopy
intents.answer: Retotalling involves re-verifying the sum of marks and checking that all answers were graded. Students can also apply for a photocopy/scanned copy of their evaluated answer script by paying the nominal fee within the specified window following results.

patterns: when will the results be published

result date for odd and even semester
intents.answer: Semester exam results are typically announced within 4 to 6 weeks after the completion of the last examination. Results can be viewed on the official college examination results portal using your Register/Roll Number and Date of Birth.

patterns: how are internal marks calculated

where to check my internal marks
what is CIA continuous internal assessment component
intents.answer: Internal marks (typically 25 to 40% of total course marks) are calculated based on Internal Assessment Tests, assignments, quizzes, seminars, and attendance. Final internal marks are published by departments before semester theory exams begin.

patterns: what is the passing criteria for exams

marks needed to pass end semester examination
intents.answer: To pass a course, students generally need at least 40% to 50% marks in the End-Semester Examination and an aggregate of 40% to 50% across combined internal and external assessments, depending on university regulations.

patterns: what is the duration of the exam

how many hours for internal test
exam timing and duration in hours
is the exam 3 hours or 2 hours
time allowed for theory paper
intents.answer: End-semester theory examinations are usually 3 hours long (100 or 75 marks papers). Internal assessment tests and practical sessions typically last 1.5 to 2 hours or 3 hours for laboratory examinations.

patterns: what is the reporting time for exam
when should I reach the examination hall

last entry time inside exam room
how many minutes before exam should I enter
intents.answer: Students must report to the examination hall at least 30 minutes before the scheduled start time. Entry into the exam hall closes 15 minutes after the exam commences, and late entrants are generally not permitted.

things to carry for semester exams
can I bring water bottle inside exam room
intents.answer: Students should bring: (1) Printed Hall Ticket, (2) Valid College ID Card, (3) Blue or Black ballpoint pens, (4) Pencils, eraser, and ruler in a transparent pouch. Transparent water bottles are permitted, while borrowing stationery inside the hall is strictly prohibited.

patterns: can I use a calculator

intents.answer: Standard non-programmable scientific calculators (e.g., Casio fx-82, fx-991 series) are allowed only for engineering, mathematics, statistics, and science subjects where explicitly specified on the question paper. Programmable and graphing calculators are strictly banned.

intents.answer: Mobile phones, smartwatches, fitness bands, Bluetooth devices, and any programmable electronics are strictly banned inside the examination hall. Carrying any digital device into the exam hall will be treated as an act of malpractice.

patterns: is college ID card mandatory for exam

intents.answer: Wearing the official College ID Card and adhering to the formal college dress code is mandatory for all examination sessions. If your ID is lost, obtain a temporary identity authorization slip from your department head or Exam Cell.

intents.answer: If you are absent for an examination, you will be marked as 'Absent' (AB) and it will be treated as an arrear. You will need to appear for that paper during the subsequent supplementary/arrear examinations.

intents.answer: In cases of severe illness or hospitalization, submit a formal medical certificate and leave application endorsed by a registered medical practitioner to the Head of Department and Examination Cell within 3 days of the missed exam for record and condonation review.

patterns: how to clear arrears

intents.answer: Arrears (backlogs) can be cleared by registering and appearing for supplementary/arrear exams held in upcoming semesters. As per university regulations, students have a maximum permissible period (usually degree duration + 2 to 3 years) to clear all courses.

intents.answer: Practical/Laboratory examinations are typically scheduled 1 to 2 weeks before the commencement of theory examinations. Students must submit their certified Laboratory Record Notebook and undergo a viva-voce evaluated jointly by internal and external examiners.

intents.answer: Project Viva-Voce examinations are held towards the end of the final semester. Students present their project work with slide decks, demonstrate working software/hardware prototypes, and submit signed project reports to the examination panel.

intents.answer: Possession of unauthorized materials (chits, notes, mobile phones), copying, or impersonation constitutes malpractice. Cases are investigated by the Examination Malpractice Committee, leading to penalties ranging from paper cancellation to semester debarment.

patterns: how to request a scribe for exam

intents.answer: Eligible differently-abled students or students with temporary physical injuries can apply for a scribe and compensatory extra time (typically 20 minutes per hour) by submitting relevant medical board certificates to the Controller of Examinations at least 15 days in advance.

patterns: how to contact the examination cell

intents.answer: The Examination Cell / Office of the Controller of Examinations (CoE) is located in the Administrative Block (Ground/1st Floor). Office hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. You can also reach them via the official college student support email.

patterns: can I write exam to improve my grades

intents.answer: Grade improvement / betterment examinations allow students who have passed a subject to re-appear to improve their grade, subject to college regulations. Check with the Controller of Examinations for eligible semesters and criteria.

patterns: how to get a duplicate hall ticket

intents.answer: If you lose your hall ticket, report to the Examination Cell with a passport-size photograph and college ID card to obtain an emergency duplicate hall ticket. For duplicate mark sheets or transcripts, submit a formal application and fee at the CoE office.
